criterion: reworked control flow in an existing method (write_atomic)
finding: The failure path drops the temp file before it restores the target's read-only mode, so a failing drop skips the restore.
why: On Windows, if os.replace fails and _drop_temp then raises (temp locked by a scanner), the target stays writable.
fix: Restore the mode before dropping the temp file.

finding: The test pins the exact word "safe.directory" in the free-text `reason` string.
why: The behaviour under test is that a failed git lookup keeps the marker and a rerun finishes, and a reword of the hint breaks the test with no change in behaviour.
fix: Assert only that a reason is present.
